decisions.decision: Pathways are computed at view time by local_ltuse from 004 tables plus local_ltuse_course_pathway
decisions.why: Nothing to hand-edit (FR-006), no plugin, FR-014 by construction
decisions.rejected: core tool_lp learning plans (rating/proficient shown, FR-011) and tool_muprog (4 plugins, second enrolment mechanism, no build API)

decisions.decision: Publisher writes delivery + target level via new local_ltuse_set_course_pathway
decisions.why: course_stage.py is the only stage authority; category is set by hand; a plugin table cannot be hand-edited
decisions.rejected: published category, badge activation, course custom field

decisions.decision: 006 enrols nobody; spec 008 owns enrolment via local_ltuse_pathway_cohort.enrol and pathway_courses_changed
decisions.why: one enrolment mechanism; manager-assignment-enrols is an unmade product decision
consistent with 004 list and competency site
decisions.rejected: spec edge case giving it a pathway (flagged to maintainer)

decisions.decision: Role pathways declared in moodle/site/pathways.yaml, shipped with roles: []
decisions.why: roles are supplied by a human, not invented

plan.summary: Plan, research R1-R13, data model, 4 contracts and quickstart written; 008 seam agreed with the a3 session
plan.key_finding: 004 already maps courses to competencies in plugin tables; pathways only need delivery + level per course on top

tasks.summary: 36 tasks: setup 2, foundational 15 in two waves, US1 4, US2 5, US3 1, US4 1, US5 3, polish 5

approach: local_ltuse computes each pathway at view time from 004's competency map and a new per-course delivery/level row written by the publisher; role pathways are applied from moodle/site/pathways.yaml; pages and an app handler show learner, mentor and manager views; 008 builds enrolment on the assignment table and events.
